title: Run a shared step
summary: Ruby on Rails: Run a shared step. Change the school name.
introduction: before_action runs before controller actions. GET /school reads the value set by the callback.
learningObjectives: Run a shared step with Ruby on Rails

blocks.text: Create a practice project with rails new school --api --skip-active-record. Enter it. Put each labelled section into its named file, then run bin/rails server -b 127.0.0.1 -p 8000. No database is needed.

blocks.title: Run a shared step
blocks.code:
# config/routes.rb
Rails.application.routes.draw do
get "/school", to: "lesson#school"
end

# app/controllers/lesson_controller.rb
class LessonController < ActionController::API
before_action :set_school
def school
 render plain: @school
end
private
def set_school
 @school = "Oak School"
end
end

blocks.text: The callback runs first and sets @school for this controller request. The action reads that value.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Callbacks can affect many actions, so keep their purpose clear.
